invoice_transaction_candidates.notes: Grounded in archived text on BOTH sides: PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(2) pulls landlord-billed service charges INTO the 10% rental base even when separately contracted, while DJP_PPH42_006 puts third-party building services at 2% under Pasal 23. A single invoice can therefore legitimately carry two treatments. Splitting is a judgement the engine must not make alone.
